text:
tara: kicking off percent rollout for api server v3.0.2 -> start 8% global. change window 10:00-12:00 UTC. will watch health and release notes for any unexpected diffs.

deploy-bot: rollout_20260510_c3 started -> 8% global. logs: https://infra.redwood/rollouts/rollout_20260510_c3

ben: quick flag: noticed schema header `x-model-metadata` changed shape in canary responses vs stable. no customer errors yet but clients may parse strictly.

kai: can you paste sample header? we have parsers that break on extra fields.

ben: sample: `x-model-metadata: {"ver":"3.0.2","quant":{"qtype":"int8","note":"beta"}}` stable is `{"ver":"3.0.1"}`

ops-ray: that's risky. client's JSON schema validation could fail. Suggest pause and pin to stable until we push a non-breaking header change.

tara: pausing now and pinning traffic. `/rollouts pause rollout_20260510_c3 --by tara`

deploy-bot: rollout_20260510_c3 -> PAUSED at 8% (operator: tara). Traffic pinned back to v3.0.1 for affected routes.

release-manager: prepare customer comms: short blurb explaining paused rollout for header compatibility, aim to release a backward-compatible header next. Also create rollback ticket just in case.

kai: i'll open a quick PR to the runtime to remove the extra metadata header field and run a small CI canary. ETA 25m.

ben: i'll run integration smoke against a sample of partner apps to ensure no parsing breaks.

[25m later]

kai: PR merged removing extra header; built v3.0.2+compat. recommending resume with 2% probe first.

tara: vote to resume at 2% and monitor ingress client errors for 15m.

release-manager: Vote: :thumbsup: resume 2% probe. status: "Paused for header compatibility; fixed and resuming small probe."

deploy-bot: rollout_20260510_c3 -> RESUMED at 2% (compat build).

ben: running partner smoke tests now; no parse errors observed. ingress error-rate steady.

[15m later]

ops-ray: 15m probe looks clean. auto-pause triggers not hit. propose advance to 25% over 20m.

tara: proceed. `/rollouts update rollout_20260510_c3 --percent 25 --step 20m`

deploy-bot: rollout_20260510_c3 -> progressing to 25% with auto-pause thresholds configured (client-parse-fail >0.1% or p95 latency +200ms).

release-manager: final note for changelog: "v3.0.2: runtime fixes; initial canary paused for header compatibility; resumed with backward-compatible header. Continuing staged rollout." Ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-8231

tara: thanks team 94 nice coordination to avoid breaking partners. keep a watch until the change window closes.
